items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So our road manager had a little Jewish road manager, Sam Flashnick (PHONETIC). He called the number.

ctx.x: "Mr. Petrillo's in there. You can't go in." I say, "Man, I'm talking about the show. I've got to go in." So I brushed past them and went in. So this cat, Petrillo, was standing up there, man, and these guys were his bodyguards. He was standing up there, talking to Duke, pointing his finger. "You can't do this, you can't do that."

So I say to Duke, "What's the matter, man?" He say, "This guy's trying to give me a hard time." Now, they still don't know Owney Madden (PHONETIC) is our representative -- boss. I say, "Get on the phone, call this number." We had to get a private number. They call this number. So Petrillo say, "Who you calling?" I say, "The man who owns our band." And he knew -- he knew the number, you know.
